note: Definition (a Prop) from OpenAI's Comparator challenge, distinct from the theorem record.
text: : Prop := ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → ∃ ε : Fin N → ℝ, IsRealSigning ε ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖littlewoodValue ε z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * Real.sqrt N
